user.title: GridMetrics setup
user.description:
Tiered / Time-of-Use Electricity Rate Calculator.

Choose how your home is metered. Pick **Solar + Grid** if you have solar panels (Enphase, etc.) and a grid meter (Shelly 3EM, etc.).

solar_production.title: Solar production sensor
solar_production.description: Select the sensor that shows live solar production. Prefer power in Watts (W) from Enphase or your inverter.

data.solar_is_energy: This sensor is cumulative kWh (not live Watts)

grid_type.title: How is the grid measured?
grid_type.description: Shelly 3EM and similar meters report each phase separately. Choose multiple phases to pick Phase A, B and C on the next screen.

grid_phases.title: Grid phase sensors
grid_phases.description:
Pick Phase A, B and/or C power sensors. Leave unused phases empty. At least one is required.

Example Shelly 3EM:
Phase A = channel_a_power
Phase B = channel_b_power
Phase C = channel_c_power

data.grid_is_energy: These are cumulative kWh sensors (not live Watts)
data.grid_sign: What does a positive number mean?

grid_single.title: Single grid sensor
grid_single.description: Select the one sensor that shows net power to/from the grid.

data.grid_is_energy: This is a cumulative kWh sensor (not live Watts)
data.grid_sign: What does a positive number mean?

source.title: Billed energy sensor
source.description: Select the cumulative energy sensor (kWh) that matches what your utility bills you for. This is usually total grid import energy, not a power (W) sensor.

tiers.title: Consumption tiers
tiers.description:
Format: max_kWh:price, max_kWh:price, ...

Aruba Elmar example:
500:0.3431,1000:0.3531,99999:0.4645

tou.title: Time-of-Use periods
tou.description:
Format: name|start|end|rate|weekdays_only separated by semicolons.

Example:
peak|18:00|22:00|0.35|true;offpeak|22:00|06:00|0.22|false

error.invalid_tou: Could not parse TOU. Use: name|HH:MM|HH:MM|rate|true/false;...
error.need_one_phase: Select at least one phase sensor (A, B or C).

general.title: General settings

data.export_rate: Buy-back / surplus rate per kWh (0 if none)
data.interconnect_free_kwp: Free capacity allowance (kWp, e.g. 3 for Elmar)

general.description: Fixed charge, tax, billing day and currency. For solar setups you can also set system capacity, interconnection fee and buy-back rate here.

sensors.title: Sensors
sensors.description: Change which entities GridMetrics reads from. Useful if your Enphase, Shelly or utility sensor's entity_id changed and stopped reporting.
